q: Deliver the Nondescript Letter to Innkeeper Renee in Tirisfal Glades.
Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.
Bring the Bundle of Furs to Innkeeper Kauth in Bloodhoof Village.
Speak with Innkeeper Farley at the Lion's Pride Inn.
Bring the Dolanaar Delivery to Innkeeper Keldamyr.
Deliver the Crate of Inn Supplies to Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos.
Bring Ukor's Burden to Innkeeper Grosk in Razor Hill.
Bring 10 Gold Dust to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire. Gold Dust is gathered from Kobolds in Elwynn Forest.
Bring Bernice's Necklace to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
Salma Saldean wants 3 Stringy Vulture Meat, 3 Goretusk Snouts, 3 Murloc Eyes, 3 Okra.
Bring Archbishop Benedictus the Cursed Eye of Paleth. Benedictus is in the Cathedral of Light, in the city of Stormwind.
Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls, then return to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.
Bring 8 Murloc Fins to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
Bring 10 Spotted Sunfish to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
Bring 10 vials of Mountain Lion Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Kill 12 Syndicate Footpads and 8 Syndicate Thieves, then return to Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill Tethis, an elusive, dangerous raptor in Stranglethorn.
Bring a Healing Potion and a Lesser Invisibility Potion to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.
Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her.
Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
Gar'Thok of Razor Hill wants you to retrieve 3 Gnomish Tools from the wreckage off the coast.
Bring the Rough Quartz to Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials.
Bring the Rough Quartz to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.
Bring Otto's Head and Falconcrest's Head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
Gather 5 Intact Raptor Horns from Sunscale Scytheclaws, and bring them to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
Bring 8 Dig Rats to Grub east of the Crossroads.
Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels.
Kill Edwin VanCleef and bring his head to Gryan Stoutmantle.
Tormus Deepforge wants you to bring 4 Runed Copper Belts and 4 Heavy Copper Mauls to Verner Osgood in Redridge.
Bring 3 Soothing Spices to "Swamp Eye" Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.
In the Name of the Light
Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.
Bring forty Mithril Bars and forty Iron Bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.
Claim your reward from Galvan the Ancient!
Mudcrush Durtfeet in northern Dustwallow wants 8 Mirefin Heads.
Deliver the Mysterious Relic to Vestia Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
Escort Dalinda Malem from Thunder Axe Fortress and then return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer in Desolace.
Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An'Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.
Place the Essence of Eranikus in the Essence Font located in this lair in the Sunken Temple.
Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Retrieve the Trader's Satchel from his corpse and return it to Nilith.
Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings.
Bring 20 Big Iron Bombs, 20 Solid Dynamite, and 5 Explosive Sheep to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands.
Shadow Priest Sarvis wants you to kill 8 Mindless Zombies and 8 Wretched Zombies.
Bring the Bank Voucher to Idriana in the bank of Darnassus.
Bring the Bank Voucher to Karus in the bank of Orgrimmar.
Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.

Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.
Return to Ironforge and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard.
To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine.
Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.
Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.
Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.
Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
Get the Book of the Ancients and return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.
Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.
Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.
Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.
Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.
Return the book to its rightful owners.
Look at the Size of It!
Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.
The Final Message to the Wildhammer

Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete.
Return the Warlords Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Venture to the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.
Speak with High Overlord Saurfang in Orgrimmar. He stands waiting for you in the Valley of Strength.
Paragons of Power: The Haruspex's Belt
Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Sash. Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale. You must also be Honored with Zandalar.

Bring 7 Cenarion Combat Badges, 4 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 4 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

Bring the the Husk of the Old God, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Bring the Skin of the Great Sandworm, 2 Idols of Strife, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Vermillion Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Launch 8 Lunar Fireworks and 2 Cluster Fireworks and return to a Lunar Festival Harbinger at any capital city.
Give Deliana your Helm of Valor and Breastplate of Valor.
Give Mokvar your Helm of Valor and Breastplate of Valor.
Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Dreadmist Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Dreadmist Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bindings of Elements to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.

Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Redemption Girdle if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Girdle, 8 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 3 Nexus Crystals.

Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Pauldrons if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Pauldrons, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 5 Cured Rugged Hides, 1 Nexus Crystal and 50 gold pieces.

Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Frostfire Bindings if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Bindings, 6 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 1 Arcane Crystal and 1 Nexus Crystal.
Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 4 Frozen Runes, 12 Thorium Bars, 2 Arcanite Bars, 2 Essence of Water and 200 gold.
Return your ward to the Stormwind orphanage by handing in the Human Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Nightingale in the Cathedral District.
Return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by handing in the Orcish Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Battlewail in the Valley of Honor.
Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms
Visit the Fire Festival camps located in Blasted Lands, Eastern Plaguelands, the Hinterlands and Searing Gorge, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
Return the Flame of Orgrimmar to the Festival Loremaster.
Return the Flame of Thunder Bluff to the Festival Loremaster.
Return the Flame of the Undercity to the Festival Loremaster.
Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.
Return the Flame of Ironforge to the Festival Talespinner.
Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.
Touch the bonfires within Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, then speak to a Festival Loremaster within the capital cities.
Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
